paper.title: PANNs: Large-Scale Pretrained Audio Neural Networks for Audio Pattern Recognition
paper.venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing 28 (2020)

inference_implementation.runtime_note: The runner imports the wheel's models module without executing the package-level AudioSet label downloader; the Cnn14 model path is unchanged.

checkpoint.pretraining: supervised multi-label AudioSet training on the full training set with balanced sampling and mixup

output.pooling: frequency mean followed by temporal max-plus-mean and fc1 ReLU

known_runtime_notes: Cnn14 applies five 2x2 temporal-frequency pooling operations followed by one 1x1 pooling operation.
The 32 kHz centered STFT produces 32 frames from 9920 samples, the minimum that survives five temporal halvings.
Embedding extraction uses float32 because the torchlibrosa spectral front end is the audited official path.
